title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments - Burning Rate Emulator (ACME BRE)
fuels: CH4/N2, C2H4/N2 (100% and 50% C2H4 bottles)
key_conditions: burner_diameter_mm: 25, 50; atmospheres: 14.7 psia / 21% O2, 10.2 psia / 26.5% O2, 8.2 psia / 34% O2, up to 40% O2 in table; ambient_flow: quiescent (no forced air flow)
habitat_relevance: steady burning without airflow in elevated-O2 atmospheres (10.2 psia/26.5%, 8.2 psia/34%) — directly relevant to Moon Base/rover atmospheres; challenges 'turn off ventilation' strategy

title: Burning and Suppression of Solids - II (BASS-II)
fuels: PMMA films (100-300 micron), PMMA rods, slabs, spherical sections, fabric sheets (SIBAL)
key_conditions: airflow_max_cm_s: 40; flow_direction: opposed, concurrent; oxygen: varied below 21% by nitrogen vitiation (e.g. 22.2% initial in sample rows)
habitat_relevance: flame spread/extinction limits vs airflow and O2 below 21%; feeds SoFIE

title: Burning and Suppression of Solids (BASS)
fuels: SIBAL cotton-fiberglass fabric (75/25), Nomex fabric, Ultem, PMMA spheres and cylinders
key_conditions: airflow_max_cm_s: 40; flow_direction: opposed, concurrent; duct_cross_section_mm: 76 x 76; suppressant: nitrogen (inert gas)
habitat_relevance: material flammability in ventilated cabins; N2 suppression

title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment (FLEX)
fuels: methanol, n-heptane, n-octane, n-decane, propanol, alkane/alcohol mixtures
hardware: Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR) - Fluids and Combustion Facility (FCF), Multi-user Droplet Combustion Apparatus (MDCA)
key_conditions: pressure_atm: 0.5-1.5 (LOI tests); droplet_diameter_mm: ~1.6-5 (≈3 mm small droplets); suppressants: CO2, He, SF6; oxygen: varied down to non-ignition to find LOI
habitat_relevance: limiting oxygen index of liquid fuels; CO2/He/SF6 suppressant efficacy; cool flames

title: Spacecraft Fire Safety Experiment-I (SAFFIRE-I)
platform: Cygnus resupply vehicle after deberthing from ISS (PSI page lists ISS)
fuels: SIBAL fabric (75% cotton / 25% fiberglass), 94 cm x 40.6 cm, 0.37 cm thick
key_conditions: airflow_cm_s: 20; oxygen_pct: 21.5-21.7; ignition_power_W: 182; flow_direction: concurrent (burn 420 s), opposed (burn 70 s)
habitat_relevance: large-scale fire growth in a spacecraft-sized volume (Cygnus)

title: Spacecraft Fire Experiment-II (SAFFIRE-II)
fuels: SIBAL, silicone (0.27-1.03 mm), structure PMMA, flat PMMA, PMMA with Nomex
key_conditions: airflow_cm_s: 20, 30; flow_direction: concurrent, opposed; samples: 9 samples, each 5 cm x 29 cm; oxygen_pct: ~21.5-22.1; ignition_power_W: 80
habitat_relevance: multi-material flammability (silicone, PMMA, Nomex, SIBAL) vs 1-g screening

title: Spacecraft Fire Experiment-III (SAFFIRE-III)
platform: Cygnus resupply vehicle after deberthing from ISS
fuels: SIBAL fabric, 94 cm x 40.6 cm, 0.33 cm thick
habitat_relevance: large SIBAL fire at 30 cm/s

title: Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment-Reflight (SAME-R)
fuels: Kapton, Teflon, silicone, Pyrell intumescent fire-retardant foam (replaced DBP)
hardware: SAME hardware (Comparative Soot Diagnostic), M-pass instrument (GRC), DustTrak, ionization detector
habitat_relevance: reflight of SAME, new materials and M-pass instrument

title: Smoke and Aerosol Measurement Experiment (SAME)
fuels: Teflon, Kapton, silicone, DBP (dibutyl phthalate), other spacecraft materials
hardware: Comparative Soot Diagnostic hardware, Microgravity Science Glovebox (MSG), thermophoretic samplers, two smoke detectors (ionization + photoelectric/DustTrak)
key_conditions: airflow_cm_s: 5, 10; weight_loss_rate_mg_min: 1, 2; aging_minutes: 1, 20; igniter_on_s: 15-60; event_duration: ~2 min
habitat_relevance: smoke particle size in microgravity -> smoke detector design

title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments Electric-Field Effects on Laminar Diffusion Flames (ACME E-FIELD Flames)
fuels: methane, ethylene (diluted with N2)
hardware: Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR), ACME (gas-jet burner and coflow burner shared with CLD Flame)
key_conditions: voltage_kV: up to 10; electrode: copper mesh above burner, controllable polarity
habitat_relevance: electric field used to mimic partial gravity (per challenge statement)

title: Dust and Aerosol Measurement Feasibility Test / DAFT-2
fuels: Arizona Road Dust (ARD Fine) aerosolized with GN2
habitat_relevance: detector instrument qualification; lunar/ISS dust vs smoke discrimination

title: Concurrent Flame Spread Modeling using Flamelet Generated Manifolds in Microgravity with Comparison to BASS Experiments using Two-Color Tomography
fuels: PMMA sheets, spheres, rods, wax cylinders
habitat_relevance: predictive flammability limits for spacecraft materials from BASS data ('Goldilocks' zone)

title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment - 2 (FLEX-2)
fuels: n-heptane, n-decane, n-dodecane, n-butanol, gasoline / surrogates, Jet-A and biofuels, decane/hexanol, binary mixtures
hardware: Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR), Multi-user Droplet Combustion Apparatus (MDCA)
key_conditions: pressure_atm: 0.5-3.0; oxygen_mole_fraction: 0.1-0.4; ignitor_s: 1-5; variables: fuel type, ambient gas composition, ambient pressure, droplet initial diameter, droplet translation velocity and acceleration, droplet spacing and initial size in a binary linear array
habitat_relevance: extinction boundaries over 0.5-3 atm and 10-40% O2

title: Smoke Point In Co-flow Experiment (SPICE)
fuels: methane, ethylene, propane, propylene, propylene mixtures
hardware: Microgravity Science Glovebox (MSG), SPICE flow duct with nozzles (later reused by BASS, BASS-II, SLICE)
habitat_relevance: smoke points/soot of non-buoyant flames; duct reused by BASS/BASS-II/SLICE

title: Utilization of the Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment Data for Advanced Modeling and Simulation of Smoke Generation in Micro-Gravity
fuels: dibutyl-phthalate (DBP) pyrolysis vapor
habitat_relevance: why microgravity smoke differs (buoyancy-free wakes)

title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments / Cool Flames Investigation with Gases (ACME CFI-G)
fuels: propane, n-butane, n-pentane, ethane
key_conditions: pressure_bar: ~1.1 in sample rows; XO2: 0.15-0.21 in sample rows; max_oxygen_note: per challenge statement, oxygen-nitrogen mixtures of up to 85% O2 flowed from the spherical burner (inverse flames) — the highest O2 concentrations of any microgravity test in PSI; flame_types: normal, inverse
habitat_relevance: highest O2 concentrations tested in microgravity (up to 85% O2 inverse flames per challenge statement)

title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments / Flame Design (ACME/Flame Design)
platform: International Space Station (ISS) and drop towers
fuels: ethylene (C2H4), methane (CH4)
hardware: Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR), ACME spherical burner
key_conditions: pressure_atm: ~1.01-1.02 in sample rows; XO2: ~0.20-0.21; adiabatic_flame_T_K: ~2186-2352; flame_types: normal, inverse
habitat_relevance: soot inception and extinction limits (peak T < 1130 K) of spherical flames

title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments / Coflow Laminar Diffusion Flame (ACME CLD Flame)
fuels: methane (diluted with N2, 25-40%), ethylene
habitat_relevance: extinction limits and soot of dilute coflow flames

title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments - Structure and Response of Spherical Diffusion Flames (ACME s-Flame)
fuels: hydrogen, methane, ethylene, H2/CH4 mixtures
hardware: Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR), ACME spherical porous burner
key_conditions: oxygen_pct: ~21% and ~30% with N2; pressure: ~1 atm, rising with vitiation
habitat_relevance: radiative vs kinetic extinction; ~21% and ~30% O2 atmospheres

title: Cool Flames Investigation (CFI)
fuels: n-dodecane, n-dodecane/iso-dodecane mixtures, farnesane
hardware: Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR), Multi-User Droplet Combustion Apparatus (MDCA)
key_conditions: pressure_atm: 0.25-5 (objectives); sample rows at 1 atm; diluents: nitrogen, helium; oxygen_sample_rows: 0.21
habitat_relevance: cool flames of liquid fuels, pressure 0.25-5 atm, He dilution

title: Computational and Experimental Analysis of SPICE Data Sets
fuels: SPICE fuels (ethylene etc.)
habitat_relevance: soot 1g vs 0g discrepancy from SPICE images

title: Structure and Liftoff In Combustion Experiment (SLICE)
fuels: methane, ethylene, nitrogen-diluted mixtures
hardware: Microgravity Science Glovebox (MSG), SPICE fan-driven flow duct with exchangeable burner tubes
habitat_relevance: flame liftoff/stability; same SPICE duct as BASS

title: Effect of External Thermo-Convective Perturbation on Cool Flame Dynamics: A Multidimensional Multi-Physics CFD Analysis
fuels: n-alkanes
habitat_relevance: cool-flame stability maps from FLEX

title: Quantitative Studies of Cool Flame Transitions at Radiation / Stretch Extinction Using Counterflow Flames
fuels: n-heptane/air, dimethyl ether (DME)/air, large n-alkanes
habitat_relevance: hot/cool/warm flame flammability diagram vs O2 and pressure
